reviewer: Codex AI manual source-refresh and deduplication review
summary: User explicitly requested that existing remote advertising sources be reviewed, merged and deduplicated together with continued phone investigation. Freshly downloaded NobyDa AdRule, w37 Advertising and Tracking plus their GPLv3 licenses. Compared exact bytes, normalized rule sets, compiler and all three curated inputs against the preceding reviewed release: no source, license, compiler, adapter or rule behavior changed. Re-examined the existing 54 explicit exclusions and two malformed-row decisions; all remain applicable, including security/activation entries awaiting user classification. Separately fetched the old Hijacking source: its SHA-256 exactly matches this run's Tracking snapshot, so it is not added as a duplicate source. Re-ran 70 project tests, including the isolated capture tool, and reviewed parent-suffix collapse, provenance and immutable script retention. No new WeChat blocking rule is introduced: phone capture execution/export and actual iOS-visible endpoints remain unverified. iPhone Mirroring screenshots showed the task-addition gallery, but automated in-phone clicks did not visibly take effect; this is not a successful phone trace or ad-blocking acceptance test. The temporary collector remains independent. Do not claim all iPhone ads or telemetry are blocked, and do not broaden MITM, disable TLS validation or replace existing personal phone settings to hide these gaps.

duplicateSourceCheck.decision: Do not add a second copy of the exact Tracking bytes; preserve source attribution in this review.

scope: App script behavior and protocol separation
no private subscription or certificate distribution
Douyin feed/image/game ad predicates and splash/cache consumer mapping
Lossless raw JSON range edits and duplicate decision-key regression
Protocol-aware exact log-path rejection without fake success or whole-domain expansion
Cross-source host/suffix/keyword overlap and original Ali behavior
knownRisks: Legacy domain lists contain stale or repurposed entries; some unobserved false positives remain possible.
Advertising click domains and shared analytics hosts are intentionally aggressive and may affect links, diagnostics and retry queues.
Current App response support derives from specific Android samples; iOS schema, certificate pinning and runtime routing remain unverified.
No scheduled updates: only a new explicit human update request starts another fetch and AI review.
Douyin sample is historical Android com.ss.android.ugc.aweme.mobile 32.2.6/320206, not the latest standard Android build or current iOS traffic.
Success Evidence subjects are unsigned, byte-preserving single-DEX carriers; cross-DEX, native, reflection and dynamic behavior remain bounded.
Feed and splash require visible supported JSON. Different iOS hosts, protobuf/encryption, certificate pinning, HTTP/3 and stale cache may leave ads.
Realtime action_type=1 and separate valid old splash inventory can still fall back to cached ads.
Shared AppLog/SDKMonitor rejection affects other apps and can retain/retry local logs; dynamic ad-click tracker paths are not claimed covered.

Phone UI clicks were not observed to succeed through the available Mirroring control connection; task execution, export failure versus zero records, and current device rule/cache state are not yet determined.
